suggestions.topic: Final DFI decisions on EIPs 7979, 8163, 8304 (default DFI if no new signals)
suggestions.rationale: Three EIPs were explicitly deferred from ACDE #245 with two-week deadline and default DFI outcomes. EIP-7979 requires Solidity/Vyper input, EIP-8163 needs L2/alt-L1 signals, EIP-8304 needs Besu/Reth engagement.

suggestions.topic: CFI pass on top-8 Forkcast EIPs (≥2.5 avg client support)
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #245 explicitly scheduled CFI pass for this call after async review window. This is the next major scoping milestone for Hegota after completing DFI pass.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8360 (TCREATE) champion status and Hegota inclusion decision
suggestions.rationale: Decision deferred two weeks from ACDE #245 with champion confirmed (Milos). This is the ephemeral-contract/SELFDESTRUCT-replacement solution that was flagged as time-sensitive in ACDE #244.

suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam devnet-9 readiness and Sepolia/Hoodi fork date confirmation
suggestions.rationale: Devnet-9 was pending client trunk merges as of ACDE #244. Sepolia (Sep 28) and Hoodi (Oct 26) dates need final ACDC confirmation. With mainnet targeting early December, testnet fork schedule is becoming time-critical.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8141 (Frames) spec iteration status and L2 collaboration update
suggestions.rationale: EIP-8141 is SFI'd as Hegota headliner but spec is still evolving. Weekly AA breakouts were established to accelerate convergence with L2s. Given ethrex flagged exclusion concerns and ACDE mandate that SFI must not block iteration, a status check is warranted.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8372/8368 (normalized state gas limit / CPSB recalibration) decision timing
suggestions.rationale: Decision deferred from ACDE #245 to be resolved alongside each other, possibly after Glamsterdam ships. EIP-8368 has broad support and is likely CFI. Clarify whether these will be decided at this call or post-Glamsterdam.

suggestions.topic: Hive chain PR #1589 resolution (EIP-7928 BAL disagreement at block 57)
suggestions.rationale: Flagged as blocking in ACDE #242 and still unresolved in ACDE #244. However, Glamsterdam testing is progressing (devnet-8 launched, devnet-9 pending), suggesting this may have been resolved async or is no longer blocking. Quick status check warranted.
